title: A deep kinematic survey of planetary nebulae in the Andromeda galaxy using the Planetary Nebula Spectrograph

evidence.locator: table3.dat: RAh/RAm/RAs, DE-/DEd/DEm/DEs (J2000), HV, Note (E/R = probable HII region or background galaxy), Host (non-M31 sources); 3,300 emission-line objects

table3.dat: 3,300 rows; 42 drawn as M32's planetary nebulae (Note E or R marks a probable HII region or background galaxy, and 'other' an object excluded as a planetary nebula by its flux (ReadMe note 1).; The survey of M31 marks the host of each object that is not M31's own (ReadMe note 2); these are the rows it gives to M32, without those it marks as uncertain.).
